title: Why B.J. Blazkowicz lost 14 years in Wolfenstein
subject: blazkowicz
description:
Could you have survived 14 years in that chair? 👇

How B.J. Blazkowicz went from a 1946 raid to a Polish asylum while the Nazis won the war. Spoilers for Wolfenstein: The New Order.

scenes.text: In 1946, a piece of shrapnel took fourteen years from B.J. Blazkowicz.
He was on an Allied raid against General Deathshead's fortress, one last push to end the war.
He woke up in a Polish asylum, unable to speak, cared for by a nurse named Anya Oliwa.
Outside those walls, the Nazis won. An atomic bomb on New York forced America to surrender.
Then, in 1960, soldiers came to close the asylum. They killed the staff, Anya's parents among them.
B.J. got out of that wheelchair, carried Anya out, and went back to his war.
